position_overview: We are looking for a creative, science-curious, and data-driven Social Media Manager to lead our digital presence. You will be the voice of Biossance across Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest, translating complex biotechnology into digestible, "shelfie-worthy" content. This role is perfect for a storyteller who understands the intersection of clean beauty, sustainability, and high-performance results.
key_responsibilities:
Develop and execute a monthly content calendar that highlights our "Squalane-First" approach, new product launches, and sustainability milestones.

Oversee daily posting and community engagement on Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and Facebook.

Stay ahead of beauty trends (like "skin streaming") and cultural shifts to ensure Biossance remains a thought leader in the clean beauty space.

 Build meaningful relationships with our "Clean Crew" community by responding to comments, DMs, and fostering user-generated content (UGC).

Work closely with our lab and education teams to turn clinical results and ingredient lists into engaging, educational videos and graphics.

Track and report on key performance indicators (engagement rate, reach, and conversion) to optimize content performance.
qualifications:
2+ years of experience in social media management, preferably within the beauty, wellness, or CPG industries.

Ability to create or curate high-quality visual content that aligns with our clean, clinical-yet-luxurious brand identity.

 You can explain why sugarcane-derived squalane is a breakthrough in 15 seconds or less.

Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or similar video editing tools.

 A genuine interest in clean beauty standards and environmental conservation.

The ability to thrive in a fully remote environment with excellent time management and communication skills.
what_we_offer:
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Remote-first work culture.

Generous product stipend (get that Biossance glow!).

Paid time off and company-observed holidays.

 Salary Range: $55,000 - $58,000 per year
